acquisition.sourceBodyRead: All seven complete official originals read. Four PDFs extracted offline and relevant pages visually inspected. No repeated origin GETs were needed.

rules: Candidate-only date observations; no canonical dates/status/publication/freshness changed.
Unknown dates do not prove open or closed. No programme cessation or complete school catalogue is certified.
Past dates bind only matched year, degree, programme and application route.
Independent awards do not borrow degree applicant cutoffs, CSCA stages or registration months.
NWNU2021 is historical context. SHUPL standing annual award wording has no exact target-year binding. SUFE Chinese listing cannot prove an English route day.
SUEP uses the current original’s explicit2026 cover and per-degree2026 autumn link; its recurring June30 rule is not rolled to2027.
Any later mutation requires a supported narrow consumer, independent approval and current-row compare-and-swap.

precisionIssues.explanation: Beijing13:00 preserved; calendar-only summaries cannot extend the application window to end of day.
May31 concerns HSK/certificate submission only; it is not the initial applicant cutoff.
The saved original is expressly2026 on cover and degree-section entry links. No successor-year extrapolation is made.
